gaps.lead: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
People claim that this herbal tea cures colds.
gaps.explanation: X is claimed to + infinitive = people claim X does.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: Jogging every morning was completely normal for him.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be accustomed to.

gaps.lead: Someone must check this equipment before every flight.
gaps.explanation: must check → must be checked (modal + be + past participle).

gaps.lead: A mechanic repaired my father's roof last week.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for somebody to do it: had his roof repaired.
